```{r}
Gel_volume <- read.csv("volume_band.txt")

        main = "Volume of Each Band",
```

```{r}

Loading_control <- read.csv("loading_control.txt")

Normalized <- (Gel_volume$Volume / Loading_control$Loading)

Normalized

```

```{r}

barplot(Normalized,
        width = 1,
        main = "Normalized Volume of Each Band to Loading Control",

        ylab = "Normalized Volume of Bands")
```
